items.noteEn: Rebuilds adult emotional foundations; new commitments to home, a partner, or self-reliance
Reverses the caretaking flow; shifting from long-time provider toward receiving support

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read This Transit in Your Timing
inline.titleEn: Five Markers to Track During the Cancer Saturn Return
inline.altEn: Sequence of five practical signs for recognizing the Cancer Saturn return as it unfolds in daily life

items.subEn: Note when you approach 29, 58, or 87; the two-to-three-year window opens gradually as Saturn nears its natal degree in Cancer
Moves, renovations, lease decisions, or a strong pull to leave or return to a family home often cluster inside this window
A recurring sense that you give far more emotional support than you receive tends to flag the core theme of this passage early
You may find yourself renegotiating family obligations you once accepted without a second thought, and feeling the discomfort of doing so
Everyday decisions about duty to family can feel unusually heavy, which is often the transit asking what is truly yours to carry
